mapper.sql: trip_plan_id AS id, user_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at
trip_plan_place_id AS id, place_id, visit_order, visit_date, memo
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_plans ( user_id, title, description, start_date, end_date ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate} )
INSERT INTO trip_plan_places ( trip_plan_id, place_id, visit_order, visit_date, memo ) VALUES ( #{tripPlanId}, #{place.placeId}, #{place.visitOrder}, #{place.visitDate}, #{place.memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trip_plan_places WHERE trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} ORDER BY visit_order, trip_plan_place_id

SELECT tpp.trip_plan_place_id AS trip_plan_place_id, tpp.place_id, p.title, p.address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.image_url, tpp.visit_order, tpp.visit_date, tpp.memo FROM trip_plan_places tpp JOIN historical_places p ON p.place_id = tpp.place_id WHERE tpp.trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} ORDER BY tpp.visit_order, tpp.trip_plan_place_id
